i: tip
Open Entropic Rift (8 sec) with Mind Blast, and keep casting Void Blast instead of Smite while it is open
aoe

While Rift is open, Voidheart increases Atonement healing by 20%, and Void Infusion increases Atonement healing from Void Blast and Penance by 75%. Lay Atonement and open Rift right before big AoE damage
tip
Before Ultimate Penitence, open Rift with Mind Blast first, and queue Void Shield just before the cast finishes (Wowhead cooldowns section)
tip
Void Blast has a lot of cast time, so it is weak on the move. When you have to move, use Penance, which casts while moving (Icy Veins)
tip
Wowhead's recommended hero talent for M+ and raid
tip
A shield-focused build. Assured Safety adds 4 stacks of Prayer of Mending to every Power Word: Shield, and Weal and Woe makes Penance bolts empower your next shield
tip
Guiding Light gives Penance 2 charges, and Twinsight makes Penance fire 3 extra bolts at both an enemy and an ally
tb
Foreseen Circumstances raises the damage reduction of Pain Suppression to 50%
tip
Shielding this often makes mana tight. If you run low on mana, cut back on regular Power Word: Shield but keep using Void Shield (Wowhead)
aoe

Evangelism · 1 min 30 sec · a 150% effective Power Word: Radiance on the target; the next 2 Radiance casts are instant and cost 40% less mana. Archangel increases healing and absorbs by 15% for 18 sec
aoe
Ultimate Penitence · 4 min · after a 1.5 sec cast, fires 24 Penance bolts over 6 sec. While airborne you get a shield for 100% of your health and are immune to knockbacks and crowd control
aoe
Power Word: Radiance · 18 sec · 2 charges (Light's Promise) · heals the target and 4 injured allies + Atonement
tb
Pain Suppression · 3 min · 2 charges (Protector of the Frail) · 40% damage taken reduction for 8 sec, usable while stunned. Each Power Word: Shield reduces its cooldown by 3 sec
tb
Power Word: Shield · 7.5 sec · 15 sec shield + Atonement. The first shield after Mind Blast is Void Shield, which hits 3 targets
tip
Desperate Prayer · 1 min 30 sec · increases max health by 25% and instantly heals for the same amount, 10 sec
tip
Fade · drops threat, Translucent Image reduces damage taken by 10%, Phantasm removes slows
disp
Mass Dispel · 2 min · removes all harmful magic from 5 allies within 15 yards
tip
Power Infusion · 2 min · 20% haste for 15 sec. Twins of the Sun Priestess gives you the same effect
disp
Purify only removes magic. Neither M+ build takes the disease dispel talent, so leave diseases and poisons to party members who can cleanse them
disp
Clear magic debuffs on several players and magic buffs on several enemies at once with Mass Dispel. For a single enemy's magic buff, use Dispel Magic

You have no interrupt. Stop casts from stacked enemies with Psychic Scream. With Petrifying Scream, enemies cower in place instead of running away
pos
Pull distant party members to you with Leap of Faith, and move with Angelic Feather
tip
You have no battle res. Keep Power Word: Fortitude up at all times and give Power Infusion to a DPS
disp
Devour week: clear the party-wide compound debuff with Mass Dispel; you can also clear it on yourself with Fade (Phantasm) (Wowhead)
cc
Ascendant week: when all orbs have dropped, Psychic Scream in the middle, then Dispel Magic the remaining orbs. Mass Dispel can neutralize 5 of them
tip
Voidbound week: Shadow Word: Death the heavily shielded Void Emissary. Voidweaver deals extra damage to the shield with Devour Matter
tip
Level 12+ Xal'atath's Guile: 15 sec lost per death

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Topicx says to spend party defensives on Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone). Before Stomp, lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance and put Void Shield up

[광역 피해] When the Ssscavenging shield goes up, put Power Infusion on a DPS and hit the shield with Penance and Smite to break it while Atonement heals the Carrion Burst stacks. Use Evangelism if the shield holds for long
[탱버] Hydrastrike's three hits are Physical damage. Keep Power Word: Shield on the tank and use Pain Suppression if they get low
[해제] The M+ builds' Purify cannot remove the Regurgitate disease, so leave it to a player who can dispel diseases
The Writhing Coil: [광역 피해] During the 35 sec Synchronized Venom DoT, keep Atonement rolling with Void Shield and Power Word: Radiance, and use Penance on cooldown
[광역 피해] Line up Ultimate Penitence with the window where 5 Writhe gather during Uncoil; as Voidweaver, open Entropic Rift with Mind Blast first
[탱버] Put Power Word: Shield on the tank before Tail Scythe
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] Topicx says to spend party defensives on the Ritual of the Fang beam-soak channel. When the channel starts, lay Atonement with Evangelism and heal with Penance and Smite; on a Ritual where Evangelism is on cooldown, use Ultimate Penitence
[참고] Players who deliberately take Boneslicer or a slowed Axegrinder axe to clear Ritual Venom need Shadow Mend right after the hit and Power Word: Shield during the 7 sec Physical DoT
[탱버] Use Pain Suppression if the tank is low during Chop Down's two hits (484912 Physical each)

Lightblossom Trinity: [광역 피해] Lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance before the 8 sec Lightbloom Overgrowth AoE damage
[참고] Penance on any of the three bosses spreads Shadow Word: Pain via Encroaching Shadows, so keep your DoT on all three bosses
[탱버] Put Power Word: Shield on the tank before Bedrock Slam
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Bloodthorn Roots is a magic effect, so remove it with Purify; if several players are rooted, clear them all at once with Mass Dispel. Phantasm does not remove these roots (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Take Thorncaller Roar with Evangelism, and save Ultimate Penitence for the Lightcrazed Frenzy phase after 50%
[회피] If you are targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, gain distance with Angelic Feather and use Penance while moving
Lightwarden Ruia: [광역 피해] After 40%, use Evangelism at the start of Spirits of the Vale, then follow with Ultimate Penitence on the next big hit

[탱버] During Moonkin Form, Warden's Wrath (48491 Nature) repeatedly hits the tank, so keep Power Word: Shield up without gaps; in Bear Form, use Pain Suppression if Mangling Claws doubling melee damage gets dangerous

[참고] The Grievous Thrash bleed only goes away at full health, so top off party members marked by Pulverizing Strikes first with Shadow Mend, and if one will take the cones with the bleed still on, use Pain Suppression on that target
Ziekket: [광역 피해] Handle the constant Oozing Xylem damage by keeping Shadow Word: Pain up and healing through Atonement from Penance and Smite
[참고] Include party members with high Lightbloom's Essence stacks in your Void Shield
[탱버] Put Power Word: Shield on the tank before the Thornspike knockback and bleed

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Lay Atonement with Power Word: Radiance before Ravenous Bellow and use Penance during the DoT
[해제] Discipline cannot cleanse the Toxic Spores poison, so leave it to a party member who can cleanse poison, and put Power Word: Shield on anyone who stepped on many mushrooms
[위치] Use Angelic Feather when heading out to step on Spoiled Supplies mushrooms
Sentinel of Winter: [해제] Clear the Glacial Torment Magic DoT with Purify, and if two or more players have it, clear them at once with Mass Dispel
[광역 피해] Cover the Frozen Tempest party DoT with Evangelism, and while slowed inside Snowdrift use Penance, which you can cast on the move

[위치] As a ranged player, take the Fractured Shivercore away from the boss as Topicx assigns. Put Penance and Mind Blast into that add so both adds die together, and turn that damage into Atonement healing
Nalorakk: [탱버] Overwhelming Onslaught (315193 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec, three hits) is where the tank uses a defensive (Topicx). Power Word: Shield the tank in advance, and use Pain Suppression if the tank has no defensive

[광역 피해] Lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance before Onslaught, and line up Ultimate Penitence with Fury of the War God. While airborne you also gain a 100% health shield and knockback immunity

[참고] The three Echoing Maul targets take 193965 Nature within 8 yards when the Echoes land. Cast Mind Blast, put Void Shield on one target to cover three players, and Power Word: Shield any target it missed

Kystia Manaheart: [해제] Clear the Corroding Spittle Magic DoT with Purify, and use Mass Dispel if several players have it (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] Use Evangelism on the 20 sec Destabilized window; Voidweaver opens Entropic Rift. Even while Felshield cuts Kystia's damage taken by 80%, a target's damage reduction does not reduce Atonement healing (Wowhead)

[탱버] Chaos Barrage (Chaos) hits the tank throughout the fight, and three in a row are dangerous (Topicx). Keep Power Word: Shield on the tank without gaps, and use Pain Suppression if back-to-back hits leave them low
Zaen Bladesorrow: [탱버] The worker pack dragged in after the RP makes tank damage high right after the pull (Topicx). Use one Pain Suppression charge on the tank then, and save the second for Envenom. Discipline cannot remove Heartstop Poison, so keep Power Word: Shield on the tank while their maximum health is cut by 30%
[광역 피해] Put Power Infusion on a DPS with the second Bloodlust and use Evangelism on Killing Spree. Refill players hit by Murder in a Row with Shadow Mend
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Power Word: Shield the tank before Legion Strike, and use Pain Suppression to carry them through the 8 sec 80% healing reduction
[탱버] Demonic Rage raises the boss's attack speed by 75% for 15 sec, so use your remaining Pain Suppression charge on the tank
[광역 피해] Lay Atonement with Power Word: Radiance before Infernal Crush. Topicx uses the third Bloodlust on the second Demonic Rage, so put Power Infusion on a DPS then; Voidweaver opens Entropic Rift
Lithiel Cinderfury: [광역 피해] Heal the constant Searing Fel Flame damage through Atonement by spreading Shadow Word: Pain to the adds with Penance. Topicx lines up DPS cooldowns with add spawns, so put Power Infusion on a DPS when the Vilefiend and Wild Imps appear
[제어] Break Felfire Burst from the Wild Imps gathered by Fingers of Gul'dan with Psychic Scream
[탱버] Furious Vilefiend adds Shadow Bite Shadow damage to every melee swing, so keep Power Word: Shield on the tank without gaps

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Topicx says to line up party utility with Dark Bloom (174568 Shadow to everyone), the biggest party damage in the fight. Lay Atonement with Evangelism or 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance before Dark Bloom

[탱버] Void Blast (271551 Shadow plus knockback) is a magic tank buster that needs a defensive every time (Topicx). Power Word: Shield the tank before the cast (2 sec), and use Pain Suppression when the tank has no defensive left
[회피] While moving to dodge orbs and Void Fissures, heal with spells you can use on the move such as Penance and Power Word: Shield, and reposition with Angelic Feather
Atroxus: [광역 피해] Topicx uses Bloodlust on the first Toxic Creeper, so put Power Infusion on a DPS then. While a Creeper is alive, put Mind Blast and Penance into it to help kill it and heal the Toxic Aura damage through Atonement
[탱버] Power Word: Shield the tank before Hulking Claw (242456 Nature plus an undispellable 10 sec Nature DoT), and use Pain Suppression if Sickening Bite stacks are high
Charonus: [광역 피해] Topicx says to use party utility during Gravitic Orbs, when players drag orbs across the pools. Use Evangelism in this window, and 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance plus Void Shield on the 20 sec Cosmic Crash DoT
[참고] As a ranged player, drag your orb to the far Unstable Singularity and move with Angelic Feather. Power Word: Shield players with stacked Condensed Mass and add Shadow Mend if needed
[탱버] Power Word: Shield the tank before Dark Waves (5 sec cast, 339438 Shadow frontal)

The Golden Serpent: [광역 피해] Lay Atonement with Power Word: Radiance before Serpentine Gust
[제어] Hold the Animated Gold spawned by Lucre's Call with Psychic Scream before it reaches the boss, and spread Shadow Word: Pain with Penance
Mchimba the Embalmer: [광역 피해] Prepare for Awakening Slam with Void Shield and Power Word: Radiance
[해제] The Wretched Discharge disease cannot be removed by Purify in the M+ build, so leave it to a party member who can cleanse disease
[참고] Drain Fluids targets must be healed above 90% to remove Desiccation, so use Shadow Mend
The Council of Tribes: [탱버] After Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand (727368 Physical), use Pain Suppression on the tank during the 10 sec of Shattered Defenses
[광역 피해] Discipline cannot remove Zanazal's Poison Nova poison, so if the interrupt is missed, heal through the 12 sec DoT with Evangelism

[참고] From the moment Zanazal is engaged, Arc Lightning (Nature) hits the tank and jumps to nearby players, so keep Power Word: Shield on the tank without gaps, and also Power Word: Shield the Severing Axe target
Dazar, The First King: [광역 피해] Lay Atonement with Evangelism right before Gilded Destruction; if Evangelism is on cooldown, use Ultimate Penitence
[탱버] If Blade Combo follows right after Savage Maul, use Pain Suppression on the tank

Melidrussa Chillworn: [광역 피해] Use Evangelism for Frost Overload in the 66% and 33% intermissions, and spread Shadow Word: Pain across the Infused Whelp pack with Penance
[탱버] Keep Power Word: Shield on the tank in case a Frigid Shard interrupt is missed
[해제] Cold Claws from Infused Whelp is a magic effect. If it stacks on several players, clear it all at once with Mass Dispel; if only one, use Purify (Wowhead)
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Put Power Word: Shield on the tank before the 4-hit Searing Blows, and use Pain Suppression if Searing Wounds stacks get high
[광역 피해] When Blazebound Firestorm spawns, lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance and heal the Inferno damage by putting Penance and Mind Blast into the Firestorm
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [광역 피해] When phase 2 (50%) starts, use Ultimate Penitence or Evangelism

[참고] Inferno Spit circles explode for 8 yards when the 6 sec DoT ends, so right before the explosion put Void Shield (3 players, upgraded by Mind Blast) on the targets. In phase 2 there are 3 targets, so one Void Shield covers them all
[해제] The Stormslam debuff (381515) is a Magic effect, so remove it with Purify before the next Stormslam and Power Word: Shield the tank

Adderis & Aspix: [참고] Hitting a boss made immune by Storm Blessed gives 0 Atonement healing. Only use Penance and Smite on the boss that is not immune (Wowhead: immune targets give no Atonement healing)
[광역 피해] When the group gathers in melee to split Thunder and Lightning, apply Void Shield and lay Atonement with Power Word: Radiance
Merektha: [광역 피해] Use Evangelism for Serpentstorm, and spread Shadow Word: Pain across the Hatch adds with Penance to heal through Atonement
[해제] Discipline cannot cleanse the Poison Spit poison, so put Power Word: Shield on the affected party member and leave it to a party member who can cleanse poison
[탱버] Lightning Bite comes every time, so rotate your 2 Pain Suppression charges
Galvazzt: [참고] Put Power Word: Shield on the beam soakers, and use Pain Suppression if a soaker whose physical damage taken is increased by Galvanized is in danger
[광역 피해] Lay Atonement with Power Word: Radiance before Induction
Avatar of Sethraliss: [참고] For 30 sec after Essence Defiler dies, pour direct healing such as Shadow Mend and ally-target Penance into the Avatar
[제어] Hold the Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer in place with Psychic Scream and run through Angelic Feather toward the tank
[탱버] Use Pain Suppression on the tank for Corrupted Guardian's Tainted Strike (484912 Physical, stacking 25 sec Shadow DoT), and Power Word: Shield the Vile Charge target (Shadow, 8 sec DoT)

1253827.d:
Casting Mind Blast upgrades your next Power Word: Shield to Void Shield.

Void Shield now reflects 10% of damage taken to enemies, causing Atonement healing.

1272363.d: When Power Word: Shield or Void Shield expires with absorption remaining, it jumps to a nearby injured ally instead. Can only happen once per shield.

1298779.d: Shadow Mend heals for 40% more and applies Atonement for an additional 4 sec, but its cast time is increased by 0.3 sec.

17.m: 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 7.5 초 재사용 대기시간
17.d: 15초 동안 아군을 보호막으로 감싸 0의 피해를 흡수합니다.

453.m: 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 5 초 재사용 대기시간
453.d: 해당 지역 내 적의 시야를 흐려 적을 인식하는 범위를 10미터만큼 감소시킵니다. 인간형과 용족 대상에게만 가능하며 위협 수준을 생성시키지 않습니다. 20초 동안 지속됩니다.

527.m: 1.3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
527.d: 대상에게 걸린 해로운 효과를 무효화하여, 모든 마법 [정화 연마: 및 질병] 효과를 제거합니다.

528.m: 특성 · 14% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
528.d: 적 대상에게 걸린 이로운 마법 효과 1개를 제거합니다.

585.m: 3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
585.d: 성스러운 일격으로 적에게 (주문력의 98.7%)의 신성 피해를 입힙니다. [성역: 적이 입히는 다음 [(암흑 주문력 * 180 / 100) * (1 + 유연성)]의 피해를 흡수합니다] [신성한 불꽃: 20%의 확률로 신성한 불꽃의 재사용 대기시간을 초기화합니다]

586.d: 몸을 희미하게 만들어 10초 동안 자신의 위협 수준을 모두 없앱니다. 추가로 적에게 감지당하는 범위가 감소합니다.

589.d: 어둠의 권능으로 즉시 (주문력의 16.8%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 추가로 16초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 99.68%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

2006.m: 0.8% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 10 초 주문 시전 시간
2006.d: 죽은 아군을 되살립니다. 대상은 35%의 생명력과 마나를 지닌 채로 되살아납니다. 전투 중에는 사용할 수 없습니다.

8092.m: 특성 · 4% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 9 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
8092.d: 대상의 정신을 강타하여 (주문력의 78.336%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 대량의 마나를 소모합니다.

8122.m: 특성 · 1.2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 40 초 재사용 대기시간
8122.d: 영혼의 절규를 부르짖어 주위 8미터 내의 모든 적이 8초 동안 달아나며 방향 감각을 상실하게 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다.

10060.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
10060.d:
대상에게 마력을 주입하여 15초 동안 가속을 20%만큼 증가시킵니다.

플레이어에게만 시전할 수 있습니다.

19236.d: 10초 동안 최대 생명력을 [빛의 감화: 35 / 25]%만큼 증가시키고, 증가한 만큼의 생명력을 즉시 회복합니다.

21562.d:
대상에게 성스러운 기운을 불어넣어, 1시간 동안 대상의 체력을 5%만큼 증가시킵니다.

대상이 같은 파티나 공격대에 속해 있다면, 모든 파티원과 공격대원이 효과를 받습니다.

32375.m: 특성 · 20% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
32375.d: 15미터 반경 내의 마법을 무효화하여 아군 대상 5명에게 걸린 모든 해로운 주문을 제거하고, 적 대상 5명으로부터 1개의 이로운 주문을 제거합니다. 일반 무효화 주문으로 해제할 수 없는 마법도 해제할 수 있습니다.

32379.m: 특성 · 0.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
32379.d:
어둠의 힘으로 대상에게 (주문력의 85%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 어둠의 권능: 죽음으로 사망하지 않으면 최대 생명력의 5%에 해당하는 반발 피해를 받습니다.

생명력이 20% 미만인 대상에게는 피해량이 150%만큼 증가합니다.

33076.m: 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
33076.d: 아군에게 수호물을 부착하여, 다음 피해를 입을 때 (주문력의 73.2%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다. 이후 회복의 기원은 30미터 반경 내의 아군에게 전달됩니다. 최대 4번까지 전달되며, 매 전달 시 30초 동안 지속됩니다.

33206.m: 특성 · 1.6% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
33206.d: 8초 동안 아군 대상이 받는 모든 피해를 40%만큼 감소시킵니다. 기절 중에도 시전할 수 있습니다.

47515.d: 직접 치유가 극대화 효과를 발휘하면 대상에게 치유량의 30%만큼 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 생성합니다. 15초 동안 지속됩니다.

47540.m: 1.28% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 집중 · 9 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
47540.d:
신성한 빛의 화살을 퍼부어, 2초에 걸쳐 적 하나에게 [(주문력의 93.2%) * 1 * 1 * (3 + 0 + 0)]의 신성 피해를 입히거나 아군 하나의 생명력을 [(주문력의 401.1%) * 1 * (3 + 0 + 0)]만큼 회복시킵니다. 이동 중에도 시전할 수 있습니다.

회개로 치유 시 자신의 속죄가 부여된 모든 대상의 생명력을 (주문력의 18.72%)만큼 회복시킵니다.

55676.d: 영혼의 절규 시전 시 대상이 도망치지 않고 제자리에서 공포에 떱니다.

73325.m: 특성 · 2.6% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
73325.d: 파티원이나 공격대원의 영혼을 끌어당겨 즉시 자신의 앞으로 이동시킵니다.

81749.d:
신의 권능: 보호막, 순간 치유, 어둠의 치유, 간청, 신의 권능: 광휘를 사용하면 15초 동안 대상에게 속죄 효과를 부여합니다.

주문 공격 시, 속죄에 영향을 받는 모든 대상의 생명력을 피해량의 46%만큼 회복시킵니다. 5명이 넘는 대상을 치유할 시 치유량이 감소합니다.

108942.d: 소실 사용 시, 모든 감속 효과에서 벗어납니다.

121536.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 3회 사용 가능
121536.d: 대상 장소에 깃털을 놓습니다. 가장 먼저 깃털을 통과해 지나는 아군은 5초 동안 이동 속도가 40%만큼 증가합니다. 동시에 3개의 깃털만 놓을 수 있습니다.

186263.m: 4% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
186263.d:
아군을 어둠으로 감싸 생명력을 (주문력의 874%)만큼 회복시키지만, 대가가 따릅니다.

아군은 모든 공격으로 총 [(주문력의 874%) / 2]의 피해를 입거나 전투에서 벗어날 때까지 1초마다 [(주문력의 874%) / 20]의 피해를 입습니다.

193063.d: 자신에게 순간 치유 또는 어둠의 치유 시전 시 10초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다.

194509.m: 특성 · 5.4% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 18 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
194509.d: 폭발적인 빛으로 대상과 40미터 내의 부상당한 아군 4명의 생명력을 (주문력의 575%)만큼 회복시키고, 기본 지속시간의 60%만큼 유지되는 속죄를 부여합니다.

197862.d: 사도가 18초 동안 치유량과 피해 흡수량을 15%만큼 증가시킵니다.

198068.m: 특성 · 매 분마다 약 1번 효과 발동됨
198068.d: 어둠의 권능: 고통 시전 시 일정 확률로 다음 회개를 암흑으로 강화하여 회개의 효과를 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

205364.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.8 초 주문 시전 시간 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
205364.d: 30초 동안 자신보다 최고 1레벨 높은 생명체의 정신을 조종합니다. 악마, 기계형, 언데드 대상이나 플레이어에게는 사용할 수 없습니다. 이 주문은 다른 방향 감각 상실 효과와 점감을 공유합니다.

212036.m: 0.8% (기본 마나 중) · 100 야드 사정거리 · 10 초 주문 시전 시간
212036.d: 죽은 파티원을 모두 되살립니다. 대상은 최대 생명력과 마나의 35%를 지닌 채 되살아납니다. 전투 중에는 사용할 수 없습니다.

238135.d: 신의 권능: 보호막이 20%의 피해를 추가로 흡수하고 지속시간이 5초만큼 증가합니다.

372972.d: 정신 분열 시전 시 100%의 확률로 어두운 면의 힘이 부여되며, 20%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

373035.d:
고통 억제가 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

신의 권능: 보호막이 고통 억제의 재사용 대기시간을 3초만큼 감소시킵니다.

373180.d: 신의 권능: 광휘 시전 시 다음 회개가 3발의 화살을 추가로 발사합니다. 최대 2번까지 중첩됩니다.

373446.d: 소실 시전 시 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다.

373466.d:
마력 주입을 아군에게 사용하면 100%의 효율로 자신에게도 시전합니다.

대상으로 지정된 아군이 없으면 주위의 아군 한 명에게 100%의 효율로 부여됩니다. 공격 담당에게 우선적으로 부여됩니다.

390685.d: 신의 권능: 광휘의 시전 시간이 30%만큼 감소합니다. 또한 시전 시 기본 지속시간의 10%만큼 유지되는 속죄를 추가로 부여합니다.

390786.d:
회개의 화살이 다음 신의 권능: 보호막의 피해 흡수량을 3%만큼 증가시킵니다.

최대 10번까지 중첩됩니다.

421453.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 4 분 재사용 대기시간
421453.d:
하늘로 날아올라 가공할 속죄의 화살을 일제히 방출합니다. 적에게는 [(주문력의 247%)> * 24]의 신성 피해를 입히고 아군은 6초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 578.5%)> * 24]만큼 치유합니다.

하늘에 떠오른 동안 생명력의 100%에 해당하는 피해 흡수 보호막을 얻으며, 추가로 밀쳐내기 또는 군중 제어 효과에 영향을 받지 않습니다.

433905.d: 순간 치유와 어둠의 치유, 신의 권능: 보호막을 자신에게 시전할 때 효과가 30%만큼 증가합니다.

440669.d: 신의의 도약을 시전한 후 6초 동안 마나를 소모하지 않고 다시 한번 시전할 수 있으며, 재사용 대기시간이 발동하지 않습니다.

440681.d: 신의 권능: 보호막의 재사용 대기시간이 1.5초만큼 감소합니다.

440738.d: 고통 억제가 받는 피해를 추가로 10%만큼 감소시킵니다.

440742.d: 회개로 아군을 치유하면 40미터 내 아군 한 명에게 회개의 화살 3발을 추가로 발사합니다. 회개로 적에게 피해를 입힐 경우에도 40미터 내의 아군에게 회개의 화살을 추가로 발사합니다.

440766.d: 신의 권능: 보호막 시전 시 대상에게 회복의 기원 4중첩을 부여합니다.

447444.d: 정신 분열 시전 시 혼돈의 균열을 열어 8초 동안 적을 따라다니게 합니다. 균열에 휘말린 적은 범위 안에 있는 동안 1초마다 (주문력의 60%)의 암흑 피해를 받습니다.

448403.d: 회개로 피해를 입히거나 생명력을 회복시킬 때마다 혼돈의 균열이 강화되어 공격력과 크기가 10%만큼 증가합니다.

449880.d: 혼돈의 균열이 활성화된 동안 속죄의 치유량이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

450405.d:
혼돈의 균열이 활성화된 동안 성스러운 일격이 공허의 폭발로 강화됩니다.

공허의 폭발:
적에게 폭발하는 우주의 공허 마력을 내보내 (주문력의 150%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. [ 암흑: 0의 광기를 생성합니다.]

450612.d: 혼돈의 균열이 활성화된 동안 공허의 폭발과 회개를 통한 속죄의 치유량이 75%만큼 증가합니다.

451311.d: 40미터 내 아군이 자신보다 더 많은 생명력을 가졌을 경우, 3초마다 자신의 생명력의 4%에 해당하는 생명력을 흡수합니다.

451840.d: 어둠의 권능: 죽음이 대상에게 부여된 피해 흡수 보호막을 흡수하여 (주문력의 255%)의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 또한 보호막이 있다면 1%의 마나를 회복합니다.

472361.d: 성스러운 일격 시전 시 활성화된 속죄의 지속시간이 2.0초만큼 증가합니다.

472433.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
472433.d: 대상에게 신의 권능: 광휘를 150%의 효율로 즉시 시전합니다. 또한 다음 2회의 신의 권능: 광휘가 즉시 시전되고 마나 소모량이 40%만큼 감소합니다.

472568.d: 대상에게 회개 시전 시 [어둠의 환희: 주위 적 2명 / 주위의 적]에게 어둠의 권능: 고통을 퍼뜨립니다.

1253593.m: 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 7.5 초 재사용 대기시간
1253593.d: 15초 동안 아군 3명을 보호막으로 감싸 0의 피해를 흡수합니다.

1253827.d:
정신 분열 시전 시 다음 신의 권능: 보호막이 공허의 보호막으로 강화됩니다.

공허의 보호막이 받은 피해의 10%를 적에게 반사하고 속죄의 치유 효과를 발동시킵니다.

1272363.d: 신의 권능: 보호막 또는 공허의 보호막이 피해 흡수량이 남은 상태로 만료되면 주위의 부상당한 아군에게 옮겨갑니다. 보호막당 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

1298779.d: 어둠의 치유가 40%만큼 생명력을 추가로 회복시키고 속죄를 추가로 4초 동안 부여하지만, 시전 시간이 0.3초만큼 증가합니다.

1: [광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret comes out with no cast and hits the whole party for 87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec. Once the pack is gathered, apply Atonement to the whole party with Evangelism (1.5 min) and use Penance on cooldown to heal through it with Atonement. When Bloodlust goes out, put Power Infusion (2 min, 20% haste for 15 sec) on a DPS.

[탱버] Use only one Pain Suppression on Virid Grovekeeper's Earthrupture Strike (533403 Physical, 2.5 sec cast) and save the second charge from Protector of the Frail for the Earthrupture Strike on pull 3. Each Power Word: Shield reduces Pain Suppression's cooldown by 3 sec.

[제어] Discipline has no interrupt. If Radiant Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove and starts channeling Frantic Blooming (8 sec), get within 8 yards and use Psychic Scream (40 sec). With Petrifying Scream the mob trembles in place instead of fleeing, which breaks the channel.
2: [광역 피해] Evangelism (1.5 min) from pull 1 is not back yet, so lay Atonement for Spouting Floret with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance (2 charges with Light's Promise, 18 sec recharge). Power Word: Radiance only applies Atonement for 70% of its normal duration (with Enduring Luminescence), so cast it after the pack is gathered.

[광역 피해] If a Light Bolt Volley (174568 Holy, 4 sec cast) from the two Radiant Spellsowers is not interrupted, cast Mind Blast to turn your next Power Word: Shield into Void Shield on 3 players, and Power Word: Shield the rest.
3: [탱버] Use the second Pain Suppression charge saved from pull 1 on Earthrupture Strike. Until pull 7 (two Luminous Thornmaws), the next pack with stacked tank busters, keep Power Word: Shield on the tank on cooldown to recharge Pain Suppression.

[참고] When Underbrush Stalker casts Thornblade (3 sec cast) on a party member, shield that target with Power Word: Shield in advance. It deals 96982 Nature followed by a 77586 Physical bleed every 2 sec for 12 sec.
5: [광역 피해] Use Evangelism (1.5 min) for Spouting Floret from the Sporeblight Belcher pulled first, and Pain Suppression for Earthrupture Strike from the Virid Grovekeeper pulled 5-6 sec later. The two do not overlap, so answer them with one cooldown each.

[회피] If you get stuck in Ruptured Earth (48491 Nature every 1 sec, 40% slow) left by Earthrupture Strike, press Fade to clear the slow with Phantasm and walk out. Translucent Image also reduces your damage taken by 10% during Fade.
7: [탱버] When Grievous Gash (387930 Physical, 2.5 sec cast) from the two Luminous Thornmaws overlaps, use Pain Suppression. The stacking bleed only goes away at full health, so follow up with ally-target Penance and Shadow Mend (40% more healing with Grim Deliverance) on the tank. Spamming Shadow Mend drains mana, so spend both Pain Suppression charges first (Icy Veins).

[참고] Put Power Word: Shield on the party member Thorny Saptor jumps on with Thornclaw Leap, and if they cannot get out of the following cone attacks, pull them in front of you with Leap of Faith (1.5 min).
8: [광역 피해] Lay Atonement for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance. If Seed Shot (116379 Nature, 2.5 sec cast) from the two Leafy Grovecrawlers is not interrupted, Power Word: Shield the target.
10: [광역 피해] Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (2 sec cast) hits the whole party for 67888 Nature and then 58189 poison damage every 1.5 sec for 9 sec. Discipline cannot remove poison, so when you see the cast, apply Atonement to everyone with Evangelism; if Evangelism is on cooldown, use 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance.
11: [광역 피해] Lay Atonement for Spouting Floret (Holy) with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance, and use Pain Suppression on Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash (Physical). Clear the bleed by topping the tank off with ally-target Penance and Shadow Mend.
[참고] If Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) from the three Lightfeather Petalwings is not interrupted, you cannot heal for 3 sec, so Power Word: Shield the tank before the cast finishes.
12: [탱버] When six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed and tank damage rises, so use Pain Suppression and keep Power Word: Shield on the tank without gaps.

[광역 피해] For Spouting Floret, use Evangelism if it is back, otherwise 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance. Put Power Infusion (2 min) on a DPS so they break the Lightbloom Pollination shield (600108) faster.

1: [해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) is a Magic effect. Clear it with Purify (8 sec, 1 charge) starting with melee, who must dodge Toxic Breath and Septic Spatter pools. If it lands on you, press Fade to remove the slow with Phantasm and save Purify for party members.

[탱버] If a single Piercing Hiss from the two Primal Serpents goes through, the tank takes 135775 armor-ignoring Physical damage and loses 30% haste for 6 sec. When you see the cast bar, cast Mind Blast to turn your next shield into Void Shield and put it on the tank and melee.
2: [광역 피해] This is the Blood Sacrifice pull (87284 Physical to the whole party, then a 162029 heal absorb) where Topicx says to spend defensives. Once the pack is gathered, apply Atonement to everyone with Evangelism (1.5 min), and after Blood Sacrifice keep casting Penance and Smite so Atonement healing chews through the absorb.

[탱버] Use only one Pain Suppression charge (3 min, 2 charges with Protector of the Frail) on the tank when you see Ritual Chieftain's Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical). Save the second charge for the Dismember on pull 3.
3: [광역 피해] The Evangelism from pull 2 is not back yet, so for Blood Sacrifice lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance (2 charges with Light's Promise) once the mobs have come down behind the pillar.
[탱버] Use the saved second Pain Suppression charge on Dismember. Until pull 5, keep Power Word: Shield on the tank on cooldown to pull the charge back 3 sec at a time.
4: [광역 피해] If Evangelism (1.5 min) is back, use it on this pull's Blood Sacrifice; if not, cover it with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance and Void Shield. Pull 5 hurts more, so do not use Ultimate Penitence here.
5: [광역 피해] Paralyzing Shots DoTs from two Twinfang Harrowers overlap with Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice absorb, and Topicx says this is hard to heal through on high keys. When Blood Sacrifice goes out, use Ultimate Penitence (4 min) to chew through the absorb with 24 Penance bolts over 6 sec; the 100% health shield while casting keeps you alive too.

[해제] When Paralyzing Shots from two Harrowers lands on several players, Purify (8 sec) cannot keep up. When the affected players are within 15 yards, clear up to 5 of them at once with Mass Dispel (2 min).
7: [광역 피해] Discipline cannot remove the Envenom poison, and it hurts when it overlaps with Rattling Writhe's Rattle (3 sec cast, 58189 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec). When you see the Rattle cast bar, cast Mind Blast, put Void Shield on the Envenom target and low players, and Power Word: Shield the rest.

[탱버] Corrosive Fangs (3 sec cast, 242456 Nature, then 20% more damage taken for 20 sec) is Nature damage, so armor does not reduce it. On the cast, use Pain Suppression on the tank to cover the first 8 sec, and keep Power Word: Shield on them on cooldown for the remaining 12 sec.

[제어] If High Evolutionist's Evolve (6 sec channel) is not stunned, use Psychic Scream (40 sec) within 8 yards. If Evolve still finishes, its shield and crowd control immunity are a Magic effect, so remove them with Dispel Magic.
8: [제어] The four Bloodletters leave a blood pool with every melee swing, so once they are stacked on the tank, stop their melee with Psychic Scream (Petrifying Scream makes them tremble in place).

[탱버] If you still have a Pain Suppression charge after pull 7, use it on Corrosive Fangs; if not, put Void Shield and Power Word: Shield on the tank before the cast to carry them through the 20 sec damage-taken increase.
9: [제어] If both High Evolutionists finish Evolve, remove both shields and crowd control immunities at once with Mass Dispel; if only one does, use Dispel Magic.
[광역 피해] When Envenom lands on two players and Rattle follows, lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance and heal through it with Penance. Leave the poison to a player who can dispel poisons.
11: [제어] When the four High Evolutionists next to the totem stack up and cast Evolve, break them together with Psychic Scream. If two or more finish Evolve, remove the shields of up to 5 enemies together with Mass Dispel.
[광역 피해] Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast, 24246 Nature every 1 sec for 8 sec) has no dispel type, so if a kick is missed, apply Atonement with Evangelism and heal through the 8 sec DoT with Penance.
12: [탱버] Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec) keeps hitting while it pushes the tank back, so use Pain Suppression (8 sec) on the tank as the cast starts to cover the whole spray.

[광역 피해] When Infest (34914 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yards) lands, stack on the tank's ping, then lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance and cover 3 players with Void Shield after Mind Blast to absorb the bursts.
13: [광역 피해] When Ula'tek's Chosen casts Toxic Surge (2 sec cast, 29095 Nature to the whole party every 1 sec for 9 sec), apply Atonement to everyone at once with Evangelism. While moving to dodge Toxic Beam (339438 Nature), heal with Penance and Power Word: Shield, which you can use on the move.

[참고] When the six Living Venoms die together, Venom Burst party damage stacks up; Topicx's group nearly wiped here. If several are about to die together, top the party with Power Word: Radiance first and put Void Shield up.
14: [광역 피해] The Evangelism (1.5 min) from pull 13 is not back yet, so cover Toxic Surge with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance and Void Shield. Save Ultimate Penitence for pull 16.
[제어] Topicx says to stun Blade of the Altar during Toxic Surge. If both Blades are near the tank, hold them with Psychic Scream to stop the Laced Edge teleports.
15: [해제] Clear Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots with Purify. If it lands on a player that one of the four Blades of the Altar also hit with Laced Edge (teleport and a Nature DoT), clear that player first and Power Word: Shield them.
[제어] When the four Blades of the Altar are stacked on the tank, use Psychic Scream (40 sec) to stop their teleport attacks.
16: [광역 피해] Two Ritual Chieftains chain Blood Sacrifice and Ula'tek's Chosen adds Toxic Surge, which Topicx calls the heaviest healing pull. If the Ultimate Penitence (4 min) from pull 5 is back, use it when the first Toxic Surge overlaps with Blood Sacrifice, and use Evangelism on the second Blood Sacrifice. Put Power Infusion (2 min) on a DPS to kill the Chosen faster.

[탱버] Dismember comes from two Chieftains, so split your two Pain Suppression charges between them. If you have only one charge, use it on the first Dismember; for the second, Power Word: Shield the tank before the cast and Shadow Mend them right after the hit.

1: [광역 피해] Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast) hits the whole party within 100 yards for 164870 Shadow. For the first cast, apply Atonement to everyone with Evangelism (1.5 min); for the next cast, put Void Shield (3 players, upgraded by Mind Blast) and Power Word: Shield out before the cast finishes. This is the first pull, so Bloodlust goes out; put Power Infusion (2 min) on a DPS.
[해제] The Minion of Zul on the way dies when its Bound by Shadow shield (Magic) is removed. Use Dispel Magic (30 yd) on the stunned Minion of Zul to strip the shield.
2: [광역 피해] If Evangelism from pull 1 is not back for the corner pack's Shadow-Borne Champion Shadow Whirlwind, lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance (2 charges with Light's Promise), and if overlapping casts are more than the party can survive, use Ultimate Penitence (4 min).

[광역 피해] Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast) is a curse, so Discipline cannot remove it. If an interrupt is missed and 38793 Shadow ticks every 1 sec for 12 sec, Power Word: Shield the affected players and keep Atonement healing going with Penance.
4: [해제] When Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (Magic) charms a party member for 10 sec, free them with Purify (8 sec). If Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending (Magic, heals 7% every 2 sec for 10 sec) is not interrupted, remove it with Dispel Magic.

[탱버] In the King A'akul pack, Blood Drain hits every bleeding target for 164870 Physical. When Bloodsworn Assassin's Sudden Rupture lands on a tank already under Mortal Bleed (18 sec, 20% less healing received), use Pain Suppression, and put Power Word: Shield on other bleeding party members to absorb Blood Drain.
[제어] When Guard Captain Atu casts Captain's Bulwark (2.5 sec cast), get within 8 yards and delay the cast with Psychic Scream (40 sec).
5: [광역 피해] Purification Construct's Purifying Flame hits the whole party for 174568 Fire with no cast and leaves a zone. While backpedaling on the bridge, press Evangelism to apply Atonement instantly and use the next 2 Power Word: Radiance casts as instant casts. Penance can be cast while moving.
[참고] On high keys, if Bloodlust is used here, put Power Infusion on a DPS.
6: [광역 피해] Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast) is a disease, and neither Mythic+ build takes Improved Purify, so Discipline cannot remove it. If an interrupt slips and 116379 Nature hits everyone every 2 sec for 12 sec, lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance and use Penance on cooldown.
7: [광역 피해] While a party member is locked in a crypt by Entomb, Interment Construct's Wail of Mourning (30 sec channel) hits everyone for 77586 Shadow every 2 sec and grows stronger. While the crypt is being opened, apply Atonement with Evangelism, and if Wretched Discharge overlaps, use Ultimate Penitence.
[회피] If you get stuck in Embalming Fluid's Putrid Seekers zone (20% slow), press Fade to clear the slow with Phantasm and walk out.
9: [광역 피해] Bloodthirsty Axe from the two Royal Berserkers bleeds up to 2 players for 29095 Physical every 1 sec for 12 sec. Power Word: Shield the bleeding targets, and top off anyone also hit by Violent Lunge (394238 Physical) with Shadow Mend.

[제어] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast Spectral Bolt and Hex nonstop, so when both are gathered on the tank, get within 8 yards and break their casts with Psychic Scream. Hex is a curse, so Discipline cannot remove it.
10: [탱버] Ghostly Brute's Soul Crush (2.5 sec cast) deals 727368 Physical and increases Physical damage taken by 30% for 15 sec. Pain Suppression (8 sec) cannot cover the full 15 sec, so apply it during the cast and keep Power Word: Shield on the tank without gaps for the remaining 7 sec.

[광역 피해] If melee get hit by Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical, knock-up), heal through it with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance. On a 4-Bloodlust route the third Bloodlust goes out here, so put Power Infusion on a DPS.
12: [해제] Shadow of Zul's Dark Revelation deals 473120 Shadow within 20 yards after 5 sec and summons Minion of Zul. Power Word: Shield the target, then kill the Minion of Zul by stripping its Bound by Shadow shield (Magic) with Dispel Magic. If there are several, use Mass Dispel (2 min, removes 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemies).
[위치] If no ranged DPS can soak the far Pool of Darkness, soak it yourself. Penance can be cast while moving, so keep healing as you walk to the pool.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull for Topicx. Put Power Infusion (2 min) on a DPS with Bloodlust, and once the pack is gathered lay Atonement with Evangelism (1.5 min) and use Penance on cooldown while the group kills Bribed Captain first.

[탱버] Both Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard cast Shield Bash (3 sec cast, 20% more Physical damage taken for 20 sec). When the second Shield Bash lands, use Pain Suppression (3 min, 2 charges) on the tank to cover the increase.

[참고] Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison is a Poison, which Discipline cannot remove. Each stack cuts maximum health by 5%, so keep Power Word: Shield on a tank with stacks on cooldown and call it out to the poison dispeller.
2: [해제] Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (6 sec disorient) is a Magic effect. If a kick is missed and a player is seduced, clear it at once with Purify (8 sec); if two players are seduced, clear them together with Mass Dispel (2 min).
3: [탱버] When Bribed Guard's Shield Bash lands, the tank takes 20% more Physical damage for 20 sec. Use the Pain Suppression charge saved from pull 1; if you have none, cast Mind Blast and cover the tank and melee with Void Shield.
[광역 피해] Each of the six Felwyrms explodes for 193965 Fire within 4 yards on death, so Power Word: Shield low melee players in advance.
4: [탱버] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks build fast (Topicx recommends two or fewer per pull). Discipline cannot remove poison, so use Pain Suppression on a tank with stacks, then keep Power Word: Shield on them on cooldown to pull the charge back 3 sec at a time.
5: [해제] Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle is a DoT that Topicx and Method call Magic. When the target calls for a dispel, clear it with Purify.

[광역 피해] Over-infused triggers Burning Fel every 3 sec, hitting the whole party within 50 yards for 38793 Fire. Once the pack is gathered lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance (2 charges with Light's Promise), and pull anyone who cannot escape Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yards) with Leap of Faith (1.5 min).
8: [광역 피해] Below 50% health, Shivan Punisher's Demonic Frenzy hits the whole party for 29095 Fire every 1 sec until it dies. When Frenzy starts, lay Atonement with Evangelism and put Power Infusion on a DPS to kill it fast.
[제어] Discipline has no interrupt. If Health Funnel (30 sec channel) from the two Fel Invokers gets past the kick rotation, break it with Psychic Scream (40 sec) within 8 yards.
9: [탱버] The Drain Life target must use a defensive or the Corrupted Warlock heals a lot (Topicx). Use Pain Suppression on that target to cut the drained damage, and if you have no charge, support them with Power Word: Shield and Shadow Mend.

[참고] Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec, split within 4 yards) is a Curse, which Discipline cannot remove. Cast Mind Blast and put Void Shield on the players stacked around the target to absorb the split damage. When Dark Pact's shield appears at 50%, consume it with Shadow Word: Death (Devour Matter, Voidweaver build).
10: [광역 피해] The Evangelism used on pull 8 may not be back for Shivan Punisher's Demonic Frenzy. If not, lay Atonement with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance just before it reaches 50% health.
[제어] If the Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel is not kicked, break it with Psychic Scream.
11: [광역 피해] For Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (2 sec cast, 43642 Fire to the whole party every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec), Topicx says to split personal and party defensives. Use Evangelism on the first Blade Dance and 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance plus Void Shield on the second.
[탱버] The two Trained Felhunters add 38793 Shadow with every melee swing through Shadow Bite, so tank magic damage stacks up. Keep Power Word: Shield on the tank without gaps.
13: [광역 피해] Topicx says to use a party defensive on Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to the whole party). On the cast, apply Atonement to everyone with Evangelism, and while walking backward to dodge Fel Beam, heal with Penance, which you can cast on the move.
[제어] When the six Unleashed Imps stack up and cast Felfire Burst, break them together with Psychic Scream.
15: [광역 피해] Topicx says not to pull Shivan Punisher and Corrupted Warlock together. If Drain Life, Demonic Frenzy, and Curse of Doom overlap, use Evangelism if it is back; if not, cover it with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance and Void Shield. Save Ultimate Penitence for pull 16.
[탱버] Use Pain Suppression on the Drain Life target, and save the second charge for the tank when Shadow Bite from the three Trained Felhunters stacks up.
16: [광역 피해] Topicx says to finish Defiled Golem within two AoEs and assign two party defensives. Use Ultimate Penitence (4 min) on the first Defiled Slam and Evangelism on the second (2 casts of Power Word: Radiance if it is not back). Put Power Infusion on a DPS so the Golem dies right after the second Slam.

1: [광역 피해] Topicx uses the first Bloodlust and cooldowns on this pull. Put Power Infusion (2 min) on a DPS with Bloodlust, and when Spirit of Hunger starts channeling Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow to the whole party every 1 sec for 5 sec), apply Atonement to everyone with Evangelism (1.5 min).

[탱버] Mother's Wrath from the two Territorial Matriarchs (50% more damage for 1 min, stacking) is an Enrage, which Discipline cannot remove. If no one can soothe it or the stacks build, use one Pain Suppression charge (3 min, 2 charges) on the tank and save the second for pull 7.

[참고] Insatiable Hunger (15% less maximum health, stacking) is a Curse, which Discipline cannot remove. At 2 stacks players lose 30% of their health cap, so cover the missing health with Power Word: Shield and Void Shield before Feast of Misery.
2: [제어] Discipline has no interrupt. If Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) goes through and lands on the mobs, it is a Magic effect, so remove it with Dispel Magic; if it is cast together with Earth Bolt, break both with Psychic Scream within 8 yards.
4: [참고] Razor Dive from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers stacks a 33944 Physical bleed every 1 sec for 10 sec on random players. Power Word: Shield the player with stacked bleeds and refill them with Shadow Mend (40% more healing with Grim Deliverance).
[광역 피해] If Evangelism from pull 1 is not back, lay Atonement for Feast of Misery with 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance (2 charges with Light's Promise).
7: [광역 피해] Topicx calls this the cooldown pull after the boss. Once the two Territorial Matriarchs and two Earthwhisper Tenders are gathered, apply Atonement with Evangelism and use Penance on cooldown.

[탱버] If the two Matriarchs' Mother's Wrath is not soothed, tank Physical damage climbs, so use the Pain Suppression charge you saved. Pull 8 also has two Matriarchs, so keep Power Word: Shield on the tank on cooldown in between to pull the charge back 3 sec at a time.
8: [탱버] Five Frostfangs bite only the tank with Frostbite (67888 Frost) and gain 60% attack speed for 10 sec with Bloodrush. With two Matriarchs on top, Topicx says tank damage is high here, so use Pain Suppression on the tank when Bloodrush goes up.

[광역 피해] Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward hits the whole party for 24246 Nature every 2 sec while the shield holds. Use Shadow Word: Death to consume the shield for extra damage (Devour Matter, Voidweaver build), and keep Atonement up with Power Word: Radiance.
9: [광역 피해] This is Topicx's second Bloodlust pull. Put Power Infusion on a DPS with Bloodlust, and once the pack is gathered apply Atonement with Evangelism to heal through Rumbling Ward's constant damage with Atonement.
[해제] Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge is a Magic effect. Allies within 4 yards of the target also take 48491 Frost, so clear it with Purify (8 sec) right away.
10: [해제] When Cryo Surge from the two Glacial Revenants lands on two players, Purify (8 sec) clears only one. If both are within 15 yards, clear them together with Mass Dispel (2 min); if not, clear the player standing in melee first.

[탱버] Topicx calls this the cooldown pull after Bloodlust. When the three Frostfangs gain Bloodrush, use Pain Suppression on the tank; if you have no charge, chain Void Shield and Power Word: Shield on them.
11: [광역 피해] When Avatar of Determination casts Glacial Tomb (2 sec cast), trapped players take 38793 Frost every 2 sec, so on the cast bar cast Mind Blast and cover 4 players with Void Shield and Power Word: Shield in advance.

[탱버] You can cast Pain Suppression even while stunned by Pulverize (4 sec cast, 387930 Physical within 12 yards and a 4 sec stun). If the tank fails to dodge Pulverize, Pain Suppression them even while you are stunned.
[광역 피해] Consume Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield with Shadow Word: Death to break it faster (Devour Matter, Voidweaver build).
